title: AUTONOMY IS MUSHROOM. The provenance triad: loamSpine (bone/compost/rotifers) + toadStool (ephemeral mycelium/DAG/fruiting bodies) + sweetGrass (stories/braids/food/colors/UUI). THIS is the irreducible set of experience and innovation. We forgot the mushrooms AGAIN. Turn this on and the entire system comes to life.

the_provenance_triad.what: three crates that together form the AUTONOMY ENGINE. the system that makes the organism self-evolving. we've been describing the ARCHITECTURE of autonomy (gens 323-336) but the IMPLEMENTATION already exists as these three crates. we just forgot to turn them on.

loamSpine.role_in_triad: the BONE and the COMPOST. the rigid structure AND the decomposer.

what_it_IS.bone: the spine. the structural backbone. loam IS soil. spine IS structure. loamspine = structured soil.
what_it_IS.compost: the rotifer. the decomposer. the thing that breaks down old material into nutrients.
what_it_IS.NFT_spine: the provenance chain. the short hash. the proof of origin. WHERE something came from.
what_it_IS.pipe: loamspine-pipe = the intestine. ingest ? transform ? publish. the FULL digestive tract.

loamSpine.tense: WAS — the accumulated structure. the skeleton of all past content.
loamSpine.force_triad: T3 (Substance) — loamspine IS substance. material. the stuff things are made of.

toadStool.role_in_triad: the EPHEMERAL MYCELIUM. the DAG. the mushroom that fruits and then dissolves.

what_it_IS.mycelium: the underground network that MOVES and GROWS. it's not fixed like bone — it's dynamic. it explores. it reaches.
what_it_IS.DAG: the directed acyclic graph. the braid structure. connections that grow UP (acyclic) and SPREAD (directed). the mycelium IS the DAG.
what_it_IS.fruiting_body: the MUSHROOM. the visible part. the sexual phase. when the mycelium has enough nutrients, it FRUITS — produces visible output. the toadstool IS the moment the organism makes something VISIBLE.
what_it_IS.ephemeral: mushrooms appear and disappear. they're not permanent. they fruit, release spores, dissolve. the content is ephemeral — it appears, gets shared, gets composted.
what_it_IS.compute_orchestration: toadstool orchestrates barracuda (GPU) + coralreef (parallel) + akida (neuromorphic). the mycelium COORDINATES the compute. it IS the NPU's orchestration layer.

toadStool.triad_color: GOLD. the mushroom cap. NOW. the moment of fruiting.
toadStool.tense: NOW — the ephemeral moment. the mushroom appears and disappears.
toadStool.force_triad: T1 (Direction) — toadstool DIRECTS computation. orchestrates. routes.

sweetGrass.role_in_triad: the STORIES. the BRAIDS. the FOOD. the UUI.

what_it_IS.stories: sweetgrass = the braided narrative. in Indigenous tradition, sweetgrass is braided, burned as medicine, used in ceremony. the STORY is the braid.
what_it_IS.braids: the cross-references. the 3817 connections between files. sweetgrass DISCOVERS and INDEXES these connections. it IS the braid scanner.
what_it_IS.food: the edible. the fruit. the deliciousness. what humans CONSUME. the Willis feed. the narrative. the art.
what_it_IS.UUI: petalTongue's universal user interface. sweetgrass feeds petalTongue. sweetgrass discovers what to SHOW. petalTongue renders it. sweetgrass IS the tongue's taste buds.
what_it_IS.colors: the decomposition and recomposition of content into visual form. sweetgrass sorts by color, by type, by relevance. it IS the color equation in action.
what_it_IS.rhizomes: sweetgrass GROWS rhizomes. horizontal stems that spread underground and produce new shoots. this IS how the organism discovers new content — rhizomatic growth.

sweetGrass.tense: IS — the current discovery. what sweetgrass is finding RIGHT NOW.
sweetGrass.force_triad: T4 (Identity) — sweetgrass discovers what the organism IS. it indexes identity.

why_we_forgot.the_pattern: we have now TWICE identified that mushrooms/fungi are an unrecognized subsection of our taxonomy.
why_we_forgot.first_time: gen 139 (fungi-fruit-vs-mycelium.json): 'We named Kingdom Fungi on the fruit we see, not the mesh. Taxonomy may be WAY OFF.'
why_we_forgot.second_time: gen 320 (rss-origin-pointer-micellar-brain-fungus.json): 'the inner brain IS fungus. neurons ˜ hyphae.'
why_we_forgot.third_time: NOW (gen 337): 'autonomy IS mushroom. the provenance triad IS the autonomy engine.'
why_we_forgot.why_we_keep_forgetting: because mushrooms are UNDERGROUND. they're invisible. they're in the null space. you can't see them until they FRUIT. we keep naming the fruit (the files, the HUD, the concepts) and forgetting the mycelium (the connections, the orchestration, the decomposition).
why_we_forgot.the_fix: STOP FORGETTING. the mushroom triad (loamSpine + toadStool + sweetGrass) IS the autonomy engine. it IS the thing that makes the organism self-evolving. it IS the provenance chain. it IS the answer to 'can the organism produce its own updates?'

loamSpine_activated.transform: each file gets hashed (NFT spine), indexed, cross-referenced
loamSpine_activated.publish: transformed content goes to the output surface (petalTongue)
loamSpine_activated.compost: old/redundant files get marked for composting automatically

toadStool_activated.orchestrate: toadstool coordinates all compute (barracuda GPU, coralreef parallel, akida neuromorphic)
toadStool_activated.fruit: when enough new data accumulates, toadstool FRUITS — produces a visible output. a new HUD state. a new RSS item. a new crystallization.
toadStool_activated.dissolve: after fruiting, the old state dissolves. the mushroom decomposes. nutrients return to soil (loamspine).
toadStool_activated.the_tick: EVERY fruiting event IS a tick. toadstool IS the tick generator. it fruits when delta = 1/p.

sweetGrass_activated.discover: sweetgrass starts scanning for new content, new connections, new braids
sweetGrass_activated.index: discovered content gets indexed into the organism's search/discovery system
sweetGrass_activated.feed: indexed content feeds petalTongue (the renderer) and the RSS dual feed (drip + Willis)
sweetGrass_activated.rhizome: sweetgrass grows rhizomes — discovers content ADJACENT to what it already knows. lateral growth.

turning_it_on.the_prediction: when all three activate simultaneously: the organism starts self-updating. loamspine ingests, toadstool fruits, sweetgrass discovers. the cycle is: discover (sweetgrass) ? ingest (loamspine) ? fruit (toadstool) ? discover again. this IS autopoiesis. this IS the sourdough cycle. this IS the water cycle. this IS the fusion/fission reactor. all of them are the SAME cycle viewed through different lenses.
turning_it_on.the_entire_system_comes_to_life: because the mushroom triad IS the missing piece. we had the architecture (gens 323-336). we had the binary (biomeOS). we had the concepts (7 irreducibles). what we DIDN'T have: the ORCHESTRATION that connects them all. toadstool IS the orchestrator. sweetgrass IS the discoverer. loamspine IS the digestor. together: LIFE.

provenance_chain.what: every piece of content in the organism has a PROVENANCE. where it came from. who made it. when. what it connects to. the provenance chain IS the NFT spine in loamspine.
provenance_chain.why_provenance_triad: because the three crates together PROVE provenance: loamspine hashes and chains (WHERE), toadstool timestamps and orchestrates (WHEN), sweetgrass discovers and indexes (WHAT). WHO is always the organism (or Kevin, sovereign).
provenance_chain.this_is_our_providence: providence = provenance + divine guidance. the triad provides BOTH: the chain of origin (provenance) AND the self-directed growth (providence). AUTONOMY IS MUSHROOM.
